project.claim_boundary_zh: 本矩阵是第三期设计合同，不是法律意见、合规认定、同意记录、合作协议、政府批准、运营承诺或已部署系统说明。
project.claim_boundary_en: This matrix is a Phase 3 design contract, not legal advice, a compliance determination, a consent record, a partnership agreement, a government approval, an operating commitment, or evidence of a deployed system.

language_contract.rule: Every human-readable governance judgment in this artifact is paired as zh/en; machine statuses remain stable English tokens.

legal_scope_notes.note_zh: 只有场景实际利用生成式人工智能向境内公众提供生成文本、图片、音频或视频时，才进入《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》第二条的相应适用判断。第十四条不得扩写为一般用户退出权；第十五条要求便捷投诉举报入口、公开流程与反馈时限，但快照没有法定数字响应时限；第十七条的安全评估、备案边界不得泛化。
legal_scope_notes.note_en: A scenario enters the corresponding Article 2 scope analysis under the Interim Measures for Generative AI Services only when it actually uses generative AI to provide generated text, images, audio, or video to the public within mainland China. Article 14 is not expanded into a general opt-out right; Article 15 calls for an accessible complaint/report channel, a published process, and a feedback time limit but supplies no statutory numeric response deadline in the snapshot; Article 17 security-assessment and filing references are not generalized.

legal_scope_notes.note_zh: 无障碍环境建设法第三十九条关于现场指导和人工办理的要求仅按医疗健康、社会保障、金融业务、生活缴费等列举事项理解；本矩阵把等效人工与低技术入口作为更广的设计合同，但不冒充所有场景的法定结论或现状合规证明。
legal_scope_notes.note_en: Article 39 of the Barrier-Free Environment Law is read only for its listed contexts such as medical care, social security, financial services, and living-expense payment. This matrix adopts equivalent human and low-tech entry as a wider design contract, not as a statutory conclusion for every scenario or proof of existing venue compliance.

legal_scope_notes.note_zh: 传统服务与智能服务并行只作为政策背景；2020—2022 阶段性目标已到期，不写成 2026 年仍在执行的具体项目法定义务、海淀落实事实或人员承诺。
legal_scope_notes.note_en: Running traditional and smart service channels in parallel is background policy context only. The 2020-2022 staged targets have expired and are not presented as a 2026 project-specific legal duty, a Haidian implementation fact, or a staffing commitment.

governance_invariants.purpose_limitation_zh: 任何字段必须同时绑定一个已列明场景目的、最小必要性和删除触发器；不能因为未来可能有用而收集。
governance_invariants.purpose_limitation_en: Every field must be bound to a listed scenario purpose, a minimum-necessity test, and a deletion trigger; collection for possible future usefulness is prohibited.
governance_invariants.no_personal_data_default_zh: 能以公开、清权、合成或运营非个人数据运行的场景，默认不采集个人数据；前台写明“不需要个人数据”，不虚构同意流程。
governance_invariants.no_personal_data_default_en: A scenario that can run on public, cleared, synthetic, or operational non-personal data collects no personal data by default; the public notice says 'no personal data required' instead of inventing a consent flow.
governance_invariants.human_authority_zh: AI 只可建议、排序、转译、辅助验证或提示；不得批准实施、改变权利、作出惩戒或资源剥夺、替代专业结论、隐藏监控或绕过责任人。
governance_invariants.human_authority_en: AI may only suggest, rank, translate, assist verification, or alert. It may not approve implementation, change rights, impose sanctions or resource deprivation, replace professional conclusions, conduct hidden monitoring, or bypass the accountable human.
governance_invariants.complaint_separation_zh: 投诉或申诉联系信息与场景输入、推荐、排程、展示和评价数据分库存取；选择匿名投诉不得降低服务优先级。
governance_invariants.complaint_separation_en: Complaint or appeal contact data is stored and accessed separately from scenario inputs, recommendations, scheduling, displays, and evaluation data; choosing an anonymous complaint must not reduce service priority.
governance_invariants.data_location_default_zh: 默认离线或场地本地处理；没有书面数据流、责任角色、安全与法律复核，不得启用远程模型端点、第三方同步或跨边界传输。
governance_invariants.data_location_default_en: Processing is offline or site-local by default. A remote model endpoint, third-party synchronization, or cross-boundary transfer remains disabled without a written data-flow map, accountable roles, security review, and legal review.
governance_invariants.retention_default_zh: 不得设置无限期保留。开放前必须书面定义评价窗口、投诉关闭条件和删除批次；没有事实依据的数字期限一律标记 design-target。
governance_invariants.retention_default_en: Indefinite retention is prohibited. Before opening, the evaluation window, complaint-closure condition, and deletion batch must be written down; any unsupported numeric duration remains a design-target.

global_prohibitions.rule_zh: 十二场景均不以人脸识别作为默认或必要输入；不得用摄像图像建立身份、到访或参与档案。
global_prohibitions.rule_en: None of the twelve scenarios uses face recognition as a default or necessary input; camera imagery may not create identity, visit, or participation records.

global_prohibitions.rule_zh: 禁止从人脸、语音、姿态、文字或生理信号推断情绪并用于评价、接管、服务或资源排序。
global_prohibitions.rule_en: Inferring emotion from faces, voice, posture, text, or physiological signals for evaluation, takeover, service, or resource ordering is prohibited.

global_prohibitions.rule_zh: 禁止对个人、群体、组织或社区形成信誉、价值、服从度或社会资格分。
global_prohibitions.rule_en: Reputation, worth, compliance, or social-eligibility scores for a person, group, organization, or community are prohibited.

global_prohibitions.rule_zh: 禁止预测性执法、风险人员名单、行为嫌疑预测和与警务惩戒相连的画像。
global_prohibitions.rule_en: Predictive policing, risk-person lists, suspicion prediction, and profiles connected to policing or sanctions are prohibited.

global_prohibitions.rule_zh: 禁止推断残障、健康、族群、宗教、政治观点、性取向、财务状况、家庭状况、儿童脆弱性或其他敏感属性。
global_prohibitions.rule_en: Inferring disability, health, ethnicity, religion, political views, sexual orientation, financial condition, family status, child vulnerability, or other sensitive attributes is prohibited.

global_prohibitions.rule_zh: 禁止未告知监控、跨场景身份串联、广告画像、数据出售、训练再利用、员工或访客绩效监控及未经说明的二次用途。
global_prohibitions.rule_en: Undisclosed monitoring, cross-scenario identity linking, advertising profiles, data sale, training reuse, worker or visitor performance surveillance, and undisclosed secondary use are prohibited.

purpose.zh: 支撑来源可追溯的说明、基准、标准、交通信息、服务信息、清权档案和 FAQ，并允许人工核验版本与适用范围。
purpose.en: Support traceable notices, benchmarks, standards, transport information, service information, cleared archives, and FAQs while allowing humans to verify version and scope.

collector.zh: 拟议来源登记员或内容维护角色
collector.en: proposed source registrar or content-maintenance role

controller.zh: 开放前书面指定的责任实体
controller.en: accountable entity to be designated in writing before opening

operator.zh: 场景内容维护、数据管理或专业复核角色
operator.en: scenario content-maintenance, data-steward, or professional-review role

access.read_zh: 公开展示只可呈现清权摘录、来源标签、日期与限制；完整本地快照服从逐项权利记录
access.read_en: public display may expose only the cleared excerpt, source label, date, and limitation; full local snapshots remain subject to their item-level rights record
access.write_zh: 仅来源登记员与获授权复核人可写
access.write_en: source registrar and authorized reviewer only

retention_deletion.retain_zh: 来源仍有真实消费者且复用获准时保留所引版本
retention_deletion.retain_en: retain the cited version while it has an active consumer and reuse remains allowed
retention_deletion.delete_or_tombstone_zh: 权利撤回或来源失效时移除展示内容；获准时只保留无内容墓碑与审计原因
retention_deletion.delete_or_tombstone_en: remove displayed content on rights withdrawal or source invalidation; retain only a non-content tombstone and audit reason when permitted

local_remote_boundary.remote_rule_zh: 远程获取只是取证事件，不自行形成权威；不得随之传输用户或运营数据
local_remote_boundary.remote_rule_en: a remote fetch is a sourcing event, not authority by itself; do not transmit user or operational data with it
local_remote_boundary.default_label_zh: 默认本地或离线，具体模式见稳定 token。
local_remote_boundary.default_label_en: Local or offline by default; see the stable token for the exact mode.

audit.trigger_zh: 来源变化、权利变化、事实争议或过期信号
audit.trigger_en: source change, rights change, factual dispute, or stale-data signal

appeal.route_zh: 前台更正／权利异议入口→内容维护角色→必要时历史、版权或专业复核；争议期间隐藏相关内容。
appeal.route_en: Front-stage correction/rights challenge -> content-maintenance role -> history, rights, or professional review when needed; hide disputed content during review.
appeal.response_window_zh: 由获授权运营者书面设定；当前为 design-target。
appeal.response_window_en: Set in writing by an authorized operator; currently design-target.

zh: 把背景或 provisional 来源升级为官方证据
忽略逐项许可或禁止用途
把撤回或过期内容当作当前主张
用仓库导航元数据替代底层来源
en: upgrade a background or provisional source into official evidence
ignore item-level license or prohibited-use fields
reuse withdrawn or stale content as a current claim
use repository navigation metadata as a substitute for the underlying source

purpose.zh: 运行设备、场地、排程、路线、内容版本和故障检测，同时避免建立人员或群体画像。
purpose.en: Operate equipment, venues, scheduling, routes, content versions, and fault detection without creating person or group profiles.

collector.zh: 拟议场景接口、设备网关或现场记录角色
collector.en: proposed scenario interface, equipment gateway, or on-site recorder

controller.zh: 开放前书面指定的责任实体
controller.en: accountable entity to be designated in writing before opening

operator.zh: 对应场景的运营、设施、安全、内容或服务角色
operator.en: the scenario's proposed operations, facility, safety, content, or service role

access.read_zh: 仅相关运营与复核席位按最小范围读取
access.read_en: authorized scenario operator and human reviewer; public sees only an aggregate or current service state
access.write_zh: 仅获授权运营席位写入
access.write_en: instrumented source or authorized human recorder
access.export_zh: 只可导出经人工复核的非个人汇总
access.export_en: non-personal aggregate only after human review

retention_deletion.retain_zh: 仅保留到运行、评价和未结事件窗口结束
retention_deletion.retain_en: through the written evaluation window and unresolved incident review only
retention_deletion.delete_or_aggregate_zh: 窗口结束删除逐次载荷，只保留获准非个人汇总与停止证据
retention_deletion.delete_or_aggregate_en: delete run-level records after evaluation and incident closure; retain only necessary non-personal aggregates and protocol version

local_remote_boundary.remote_rule_zh: 默认场地本地；远程传输须有书面数据流、安全与法律复核
local_remote_boundary.remote_rule_en: remote telemetry or synchronization is disabled until a documented data-flow, operator, security review, and legal review exist
local_remote_boundary.default_label_zh: 默认本地或离线，具体模式见稳定 token。
local_remote_boundary.default_label_en: Local or offline by default; see the stable token for the exact mode.

audit.trigger_zh: 版本、阈值、故障、投诉、状态或访问变化
audit.trigger_en: quality failure, drift, safety threshold, missing log, or source disconnect

appeal.route_zh: 公众可质疑数据来源、过期状态或服务后果；运营角色暂停相关输出并由人工核验原始非个人记录。
appeal.route_en: The public may challenge a data source, stale state, or service consequence; the operator pauses the related output and a human checks the underlying non-personal record.
appeal.response_window_zh: 由获授权运营者书面设定；当前为 design-target。
appeal.response_window_en: Set in writing by an authorized operator; currently design-target.

zh: 把运营数据与身份拼接
形成隐蔽人员或客流画像
未经复核用于训练或营销
用设备遥测替代专业结论
en: re-identify a person from operational traces
combine device, route, or slot records into attendance or worker-performance profiles
treat an uncalibrated sensor or unverified route as professional evidence

purpose.zh: 仅在用户主动请求引荐、预约、回访、人工转接、贡献署名或投诉回复且无更少数据替代时，完成该项明确请求。
purpose.en: Only when a user actively requests a referral, booking, follow-up, human transfer, attributed contribution, or complaint reply and no less-data alternative exists, complete that explicit request.

collector.zh: 用户主动提交的人工柜台或明确标注的场景表单
collector.en: a human desk or clearly labelled scenario form used through active user submission

controller.zh: 必须在任何收集前书面指定并前台公示；当前未知
controller.en: must be designated in writing and disclosed before any collection; currently unknown

operator.zh: 按需访问的人工顾问、设施管理员、投诉处理或内容权利角色
operator.en: need-to-know human adviser, facility administrator, complaint handler, or content-rights role

access.read_zh: 仅处理请求所必需的具名人工席位可读
access.write_zh: 仅在条件路径启用后由获授权人工写入
access.write_en: data subject or authorized human intake role
access.ai_access_zh: 默认不向 AI 提供；如不可避免须另行法律、安全与目的复核
access.ai_access_en: disabled by default; any field passed to AI requires field-level necessity and legal review
access.separation_zh: 联系信息与推荐、排程、展示和评价数据分离
access.separation_en: contact data is separated from ranking, evaluation, and public display

retention_deletion.retain_zh: 只保留至请求、投诉或权利行使闭环
retention_deletion.retain_en: until the requested referral, booking, reply, correction, or appeal is closed, subject to a written pre-open schedule
retention_deletion.delete_zh: 闭环后按书面批次删除
retention_deletion.delete_en: delete or irreversibly de-identify after closure and any specifically verified mandatory hold; do not use a blanket legal-hold claim
retention_deletion.withdrawal_zh: 撤回或反对触发隔离、停止处理与删除/封存复核
retention_deletion.withdrawal_en: stop optional processing and delete when the user withdraws, unless an authorized legal review identifies a specific contrary duty

local_remote_boundary.remote_rule_zh: 默认本地分库存取；远程端点和跨边界传输关闭，除非书面法律与安全复核通过
local_remote_boundary.remote_rule_en: no remote model, vendor, synchronization, or cross-boundary transfer until a controller, processor boundary, location, security measure, user notice, and legal basis are documented
local_remote_boundary.default_label_zh: 默认本地或离线，具体模式见稳定 token。
local_remote_boundary.default_label_en: Local or offline by default; see the stable token for the exact mode.

audit.trigger_zh: 收集、读取、更正、撤回、导出、泄露或删除事件
audit.trigger_en: collection attempt, access, purpose change, correction, withdrawal, leak, or deletion failure

appeal.route_zh: 匿名意见可不留联系方式；需回复时只收用户选择的单一联系渠道。投诉处理角色不得把投诉内容回流到匹配、排程、评价或展示。
appeal.route_en: Anonymous feedback needs no contact detail; when a reply is requested, collect only one user-selected contact channel. The complaint role may not feed complaint content back into matching, scheduling, evaluation, or display.
appeal.response_window_zh: 由获授权运营者书面设定；当前为 design-target。
appeal.response_window_en: Set in writing by an authorized operator; currently design-target.

zh: 强迫同意或以拒绝降低服务
用于招聘、营销、训练或其他未告知用途
en: collect personal data for a scenario whose core service does not require it
condition equivalent service on accepting AI or personal-data processing
secondary marketing, model training, identity linking, eligibility scoring, or public display
infer consent from entry into a venue, use of a paper fallback, or silence

purpose.zh: 当前十二场景没有已证实的必要目的；默认不采集、不推断、不存储。
purpose.en: No necessary purpose is established for the current twelve scenarios; collection, inference, and storage are prohibited by default.

collector.zh: 无；界面应阻止或警示提交
collector.en: none; the interface should block or warn against submission

controller.zh: 未指定，因为当前合同禁止处理
controller.en: not designated because processing is prohibited under the current contract

operator.zh: 误收时仅由授权事件处理角色隔离、删除并记录最小事件元数据
operator.en: if received accidentally, only an authorized incident role quarantines and deletes it while recording minimum event metadata

access.incident_access_zh: 当前场景均不需要；意外收到时仅安全、法律与权利复核席位可隔离处理
access.incident_access_en: authorized incident handler only for quarantine and deletion

retention_deletion.delete_zh: 立即隔离并按事故程序删除
retention_deletion.delete_en: quarantine and delete accidental submission without copying its content into incident or appeal logs
retention_deletion.exception_zh: 仅法律明确要求的事件证据可在限制访问下封存，当前为 requires legal review
retention_deletion.exception_en: any proposed exception is outside the current protocol and requires a necessity finding, legal review, security review, and an explicit protocol change before collection

local_remote_boundary.remote_rule_zh: 禁止远程传输，除非未来法律审查明确要求并另立合同
local_remote_boundary.default_label_zh: 默认本地或离线，具体模式见稳定 token。
local_remote_boundary.default_label_en: Local or offline by default; see the stable token for the exact mode.

audit.trigger_zh: 任何疑似敏感数据输入、访问、推断、泄露或删除事件

appeal.route_zh: 用户可要求确认停止处理与删除；回复不复述敏感内容。
appeal.route_en: A user may request confirmation that processing stopped and deletion occurred; the reply does not repeat sensitive content.
appeal.response_window_zh: 由获授权运营者书面设定；当前为 design-target。
appeal.response_window_en: Set in writing by an authorized operator; currently design-target.

zh: 健康、残障、族群、政治或脆弱性推断
社会评分与预测性执法
en: risk, eligibility, discipline, price, or service ranking

purpose.zh: 只生成面向模型、设备、路线、内容或候选匹配的可解释建议、排序、转译、验证辅助或风险提示，并交由人决定。
purpose.en: Generate only explainable suggestions, rankings, translations, verification assistance, or risk alerts concerning models, equipment, routes, content, or candidate matches, with a human making the decision.

collector.zh: 不单独采集；只读取该场景已允许的最小输入
collector.en: no separate collection; reads only the scenario's already allowed minimum inputs

controller.zh: 开放前书面指定的责任实体
controller.en: accountable entity to be designated in writing before opening

operator.zh: 场景运营与相应安全、专业、顾问、设施、历史或服务复核角色
operator.en: scenario operations plus the applicable safety, professional, adviser, facility, history, or service-review role

access.read_zh: 人工运营与复核席位按场景目的读取
access.read_en: human reviewer sees the input categories, source version, output, limitation, and override control
access.write_zh: 仅系统生成并附版本、来源与限制
access.write_en: model or deterministic rule produces a draft; only the human role records the decision
access.public_zh: 公众只看经人工复核的限定输出与解释
access.public_en: display must distinguish AI output from human decision and show how to request Human Takeover

retention_deletion.retain_zh: 保留到评价、异常和申诉窗口结束
retention_deletion.retain_en: keep the minimum run record through evaluation or dispute review; do not retain prompts or raw outputs by default
retention_deletion.delete_or_aggregate_zh: 删除逐次推断，只保留获准非个人错误类别与决定证据
retention_deletion.delete_or_aggregate_en: delete session content after the service or trial window; retain only non-personal aggregate error classes and versioned decisions when needed

local_remote_boundary.remote_rule_zh: 默认本地；远程模型调用必须预检数据流、权限、版本和退出
local_remote_boundary.remote_rule_en: remote inference is disabled by default; if later proposed, only non-personal minimum input may be sent after endpoint, location, logging, security, rights, and legal review
local_remote_boundary.default_label_zh: 默认本地或离线，具体模式见稳定 token。
local_remote_boundary.default_label_en: Local or offline by default; see the stable token for the exact mode.

audit.trigger_zh: 模型、提示、来源、规则、偏差、漂移或人工推翻变化
audit.trigger_en: wrong suggestion, discriminatory pattern, drift, unexplained output, missing source, or human override

appeal.route_zh: 用户可拒绝 AI 建议、要求人工说明或改走低技术路径；拒绝不得带来服务降级、惩罚或排队劣势。
appeal.route_en: A user may reject the AI suggestion, request a human explanation, or use the low-tech route; refusal must not reduce service, impose a penalty, or worsen queue priority.
appeal.response_window_zh: 由获授权运营者书面设定；当前为 design-target。
appeal.response_window_en: Set in writing by an authorized operator; currently design-target.

zh: 把分数当批准或权利决定
人员社会评分或敏感属性推断
自动惩戒、拒绝资源或资格
隐藏不确定性或人工推翻
en: automated approval, eligibility, purchase, sanction, resource deprivation, or rights change
person-level reputation, risk, emotion, disability, health, or vulnerability scoring
predictive policing or worker/visitor performance scoring
hide source, model version, limitation, or human override
train on scenario inputs, feedback, or appeals without a separate authorized protocol

purpose.zh: 证明状态、来源、人工决定、接管、暂停、停止、撤场、投诉和删除是否发生，并让更正与复测可追溯。
purpose.en: Evidence whether state, source, human decision, takeover, pause, stop, removal, complaint, and deletion events occurred, enabling traceable correction and retest.

collector.zh: 拟议事件记录器与人工投诉台
collector.en: proposed event recorder and human complaint desk

controller.zh: 开放前书面指定的责任实体
controller.en: accountable entity to be designated in writing before opening

operator.zh: 独立于场景推荐和评价的投诉处理、数据治理与责任复核角色
operator.en: complaint-handling, data-governance, and accountability-review roles separated from scenario recommendation and evaluation

access.read_zh: 按事件最小范围向投诉、审计和独立复核席位开放
access.read_en: complaint handler and authorized audit role; scenario operator sees only the action needed, not unnecessary complainant identity
access.write_zh: 只允许具名人工席位与防篡改系统事件写入
access.write_en: append-only event role plus human correction workflow
access.public_zh: 只公开去个人化结论、处置和限制
access.public_en: publish only non-personal status and aggregate findings after review

retention_deletion.retain_zh: 保留至投诉、申诉、事故、删除和公开复盘闭环
retention_deletion.retain_en: through evaluation, complaint closure, and required retest; any further hold needs a specifically documented reason and legal review
retention_deletion.delete_or_aggregate_zh: 闭环后删除非必要个人材料，保留获准索引、决定和删除证据
retention_deletion.delete_or_aggregate_en: remove contact and narrative after closure; retain non-personal event class, outcome, protocol correction, and deletion proof when necessary

local_remote_boundary.remote_rule_zh: 默认本地受限库；远程案件系统须另行法律、安全和访问复核
local_remote_boundary.remote_rule_en: no third-party ticketing or remote synchronization until vendor, location, access, security, retention, and legal boundaries are written
local_remote_boundary.default_label_zh: 默认本地或离线，具体模式见稳定 token。
local_remote_boundary.default_label_en: Local or offline by default; see the stable token for the exact mode.

audit.trigger_zh: 投诉收件、分派、读取、决定、再申诉、停止、删除或归档
audit.trigger_en: every state change, Human Takeover, complaint, correction, stop, removal, reopen, or deletion

appeal.route_zh: 前台纸面、柜台或可访问数字入口→独立投诉角色→责任人复核→结果、纠正和复测说明；无法到达投诉入口本身即触发 Human Takeover 和停止评估。
appeal.route_en: Front-stage paper, counter, or accessible digital entry -> independent complaint role -> accountable review -> outcome, correction, and retest explanation; an unreachable complaint channel itself triggers Human Takeover and stop assessment.
appeal.response_window_zh: 由获授权运营者书面设定；当前为 design-target。
appeal.response_window_en: Set in writing by an authorized operator; currently design-target.

zh: 删除未结申诉或事故证据
向产品方暴露匿名投诉者
把投诉材料用于训练、营销或人员画像
en: retaliation, queue penalty, recommendation downgrade, or service denial because a person complained
use complaints to train or rank people
delete or alter an unresolved incident trail without a recorded authorized reason

scenario_profiles.purpose_zh: 用公开或清权基准、合成数据和可复核日志辅助模型评测，由安全角色决定放行或停止。
scenario_profiles.purpose_en: Assist model evaluation using public or cleared benchmarks, synthetic data, and reviewable logs, with a safety role deciding release or stop.
scenario_profiles.notice_zh: 不需要个人数据；不得上传真实个人输入或敏感材料。评测分数只评价模型／系统，不评价人。
scenario_profiles.notice_en: No personal data required; do not upload real personal inputs or sensitive material. Evaluation scores assess only a model/system, not a person.

human_decision.zh: 放行、限制、隔离、复测或停止
human_decision.en: release, restrict, isolate, retest, or stop

retention_override.zh: 评测与异常窗口后删除逐次载荷；只保留非个人协议、结果汇总与停止证据
retention_override.en: delete run-level payload after the evaluation and anomaly window; retain non-personal protocol/result aggregates and stop evidence only

zh: 无人工安全决定即生产放行
en: production release without a human safety decision

access.zh: 仅具名责任席位按场景目的和最小必要范围访问。
access.en: Only named accountable roles access data within scenario purpose and minimum necessity.

retention_deletion.zh: 评测与异常窗口后删除逐次载荷；只保留非个人协议、结果汇总与停止证据
retention_deletion.en: delete run-level payload after the evaluation and anomaly window; retain non-personal protocol/result aggregates and stop evidence only

local_remote_boundary.zh: 默认本地或离线；远程能力须书面数据流、安全与法律复核。
local_remote_boundary.en: Local or offline by default; remote capability requires a written data flow, security review, and legal review.

audit.trigger_en: Input, access, version, state, complaint, rights, or deletion change.

appeal.en: Non-AI entry -> receipt -> independent human review -> outcome notice -> re-appeal to a different person.

scenario_profiles.purpose_zh: 读取清权设备遥测并辅助识别能效、热、消防或噪声异常，由相应专业人员确认。
scenario_profiles.purpose_en: Read cleared device telemetry and assist identification of energy, thermal, fire, or noise anomalies for confirmation by the relevant professional role.
scenario_profiles.notice_zh: 只处理设备状态，不建立人员、工位或到访档案；专业阈值和结论必须由能源、消防或噪声专业角色确认。
scenario_profiles.notice_en: Only equipment state is processed; no person, workstation, or visit record is created. Energy, fire, or noise thresholds and conclusions require confirmation by the relevant professional role.

human_decision.zh: 确认、拒绝、隔离设备或停止试验
human_decision.en: confirm, reject, isolate equipment, or stop test

retention_override.zh: 受控试验与未结事件复核后删除或聚合原始遥测
retention_override.en: retain raw telemetry only through the controlled test and unresolved incident review, then aggregate or delete

scenario_profiles.purpose_zh: 用自愿任务、环境状态和安全事件辅助共测具身系统，不建立参与者身份或残障画像。
scenario_profiles.purpose_en: Use voluntary tasks, environmental state, and safety events to assist co-testing of an embodied system without creating participant identity or disability profiles.
scenario_profiles.notice_zh: 无需姓名、诊断、残障类别、人脸、声音或步态模板；可跳过任务并改由人工陪同，不影响获得等效服务。
scenario_profiles.notice_en: No name, diagnosis, disability category, face, voice, or gait template is required. A participant may skip a task and use a human escort without losing equivalent service.

human_decision.zh: 开始、调整任务、陪同、停止或复测
human_decision.en: start, adapt task, provide escort, stop, or retest

retention_override.zh: 只保留非个人任务与安全事件至复核结束；意外身份或健康细节立即删除

en: testing without an on-site safety host

conditional_personal_data.condition_zh: 仅用户请求署名或回复

minimum_fields_zh: 展示名或单一联系渠道

scenario_profiles.notice_en: Anonymous or unattributed participation receives no lower priority. AI summarization does not imply endorsement by the facilitator, a standards body, or a contributor.

human_decision.zh: 确认归属、更正、发布、隐藏或下架
human_decision.en: confirm attribution, correct, publish, hide, or take down

scenario_profiles.purpose_en: Use a minimum user-supplied, match-permitted summary and public needs to generate candidate matches, with a human adviser deciding whether to refer.
scenario_profiles.notice_zh: AI 只给候选与理由，不批准引荐、岗位、资金、采购、空间、资格或背书；可拒绝 AI 并直接找人工顾问。

scenario_profiles.notice_en: No login or persistent profile is required. Results are not eligibility decisions for benefits, housing, education, employment, medical care, or any other service; stale, discriminatory, or unmaintained results pause the service.

retention_override.zh: 不保存会话选择；人工回访与回复闭环后删除可选联系信息

scenario_profiles.purpose_en: Use future field-verified paths, barriers, states, and service points for explainable route guidance and human escort without continuous identity tracking.
scenario_profiles.notice_zh: 无需姓名、诊断或残障类别；起终点只用于当次路线，不形成位置历史。现场无障碍审计未完成或人工求助不可达时关闭 AI 路线并提供纸图或人工带领。
scenario_profiles.notice_en: No name, diagnosis, or disability category is required. Origin and destination are used only for the current route and do not form location history. If the field accessibility audit is incomplete or human help is unreachable, close AI routing and offer a paper map or human escort.

human_decision.zh: 核验路线、关闭路线、选择替代或陪同

retention_override.zh: 会话后不保留起终点或路线选择；只留非个人障碍与关闭记录

conditional_personal_data.condition_zh: 仅用户请求投诉回复；不含产品自身个人数据处理
conditional_personal_data.condition_en: only for a requested complaint reply; product-specific processing is outside this contract
conditional_personal_data.not_claimed_zh: 不宣称已完成法律审查、已获同意或已启用该路径。
conditional_personal_data.not_claimed_en: No completed legal review, obtained consent, or activated path is claimed.

scenario_profiles.notice_zh: 不需要个人数据；不得输入人脸、身份、敏感材料或第三方秘密。AI 不自动购买、定价、授信、批准、惩戒或改变权利；可随时退出并改听人工说明。
scenario_profiles.notice_en: No personal data required; do not submit faces, identity data, sensitive material, or third-party secrets. AI does not automate purchase, price, credit, approval, sanction, or rights changes. A visitor may exit at any time and use a human explanation.

human_decision.zh: 在书面范围内开放、接管、暂停、停止、撤场、归档或决定新实例预检

scenario_profiles.notice_en: AI translation is not a historical ruling. A contributor may choose anonymous, pseudonymous, or attributed participation and request correction/withdrawal. Sensitive content does not enter the model or display.

scenario_profiles.title_zh: 跨三原型公共 FAQ 与人工转接
scenario_profiles.title_en: All-Prototypes Public FAQ and Human Transfer
scenario_profiles.purpose_zh: 引用带来源与日期的公开 FAQ 回答低风险事实问题，并把高风险或超范围问题转给人工服务角色。
scenario_profiles.purpose_en: Use sourced, dated public FAQs for low-risk factual questions and transfer high-risk or out-of-scope questions to a human service role.

conditional_personal_data.condition_zh: 仅用户请求人工回复；高风险个人叙事直接转人工且不进入 AI 日志
conditional_personal_data.condition_en: only for a requested human reply; high-risk personal narratives transfer directly to a human and do not enter the AI log
conditional_personal_data.not_claimed_zh: 不宣称已完成法律审查、已获同意或已启用该路径。
conditional_personal_data.not_claimed_en: No completed legal review, obtained consent, or activated path is claimed.

scenario_profiles.notice_zh: 无需登录或个人数据；不替代法律、医疗、消防、应急、交通调度或其他专业结论。可拒绝 AI，直接使用柜台或人工转接。
scenario_profiles.notice_en: No login or personal data required. The service does not replace legal, medical, fire, emergency, transport-dispatch, or other professional conclusions. A user may refuse AI and use the counter or human transfer directly.

human_decision.zh: 人工回答、转接、更正、降级、暂停或停止
human_decision.en: answer manually, transfer, correct, degrade, pause, or stop

retention_override.zh: 默认不保留问题文本；只留非个人问题类别、来源版本、转接可达和更正事件
retention_override.en: do not retain question text by default; keep only non-personal question class, source version, transfer reachability, and correction events

protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_zh: 与 AI 路径同一服务目的、同一人工责任链和同一投诉入口；不得强制使用智能手机、扫码、注册或 AI。
protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_en: The same service purpose, human accountability chain, and complaint entry as the AI route; no mandatory smartphone, QR scan, registration, or AI use.
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_zh: 纸面说明／表格、静态地图、现场柜台或人工带领；具体人员配置仍为 design-target。
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_en: Paper notice/form, static map, on-site counter, or human escort; actual staffing remains a design-target.
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_zh: 大字、清晰口语和分步说明；不得写成已提供 24H 服务。
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_en: Large print, clear spoken language, and step-by-step explanation; no claim of existing 24-hour service.
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_zh: 拒绝 AI 或不留个人数据不降低服务、排队或申诉优先级。
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_en: Refusing AI or personal-data submission does not reduce service, queue, or complaint priority.
protected_user_equivalence.source_boundary: DATA-SRC-ELDERLY-SMART-TECH-PLAN-2020-45 is background only; local implementation and staffing remain unknown

protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_zh: 可达的同等入口、人工责任与投诉路径；不要求披露诊断或残障类别。
protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_en: An accessible equivalent entry, human accountability, and complaint path without requiring diagnosis or disability-category disclosure.
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_zh: 低位／可达柜台、纸图、人工带领、文字与音频替代；具体设施与现场连续性待核验。
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_en: Low/reachable counter, paper map, human escort, and text/audio alternatives; specific facilities and on-site continuity await verification.
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_zh: 由无障碍复核或服务角色按用户选择说明，不用 AI 猜测其需求。
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_en: An accessibility-review or service role explains according to user choice; AI does not infer need.
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_zh: 可跳过共测、路线推荐或任何 AI 输入并改走人工路径。
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_en: A user may skip co-testing, route recommendation, or any AI input and use the human route.
protected_user_equivalence.source_boundary: Barrier-Free Environment Law informs accessibility context but does not prove venue compliance

protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_zh: 不以儿童画像、行为评分、营销或沉浸时长换取服务；默认由人工、照护者或教育者在场。
protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_en: Service is not exchanged for child profiling, behavior scoring, marketing, or engagement time; a human, carer, or educator is present by default.
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_zh: 年龄适宜的纸面说明、人工主持和可立即离开的观察路径。
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_en: Age-appropriate paper explanation, human facilitation, and an observation route that can be exited immediately.
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_zh: 用年龄适宜语言说明 AI 不是人、可能出错、可拒绝；监护与许可规则须法律复核。
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_en: Use age-appropriate language to explain that AI is not a person, can be wrong, and can be refused; guardianship and permission rules require legal review.
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_zh: 儿童或照护者可随时退出，不保留其输入、图像、声音或行为记录。
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_en: A child or carer may exit at any time; input, image, voice, or behavior records are not retained.

protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_zh: 核心服务不得依赖自带智能手机、App、账号、二维码或移动支付。
protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_en: Core service does not depend on a personal smartphone, app, account, QR code, or mobile payment.
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_zh: 纸面号码／预约、静态信息牌、现场表格、柜台与人工转接。
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_en: Paper queue/booking, static information board, on-site form, counter, and human transfer.
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_zh: 工作人员可解释状态、来源、选择和退出，不要求用户借用他人设备。
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_en: Staff can explain status, source, choices, and exit without requiring a user to borrow another person's device.
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_zh: 选择纸面或柜台不产生额外费用、排队劣势或服务降级。
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_en: Choosing paper or counter creates no added fee, queue disadvantage, or service downgrade.

protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_zh: 至少保持当前中英双语的状态、限制、人工接管和投诉信息实质等价；其他语言需求未知。
protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_en: At minimum, maintain substantive Chinese-English parity for status, limitations, Human Takeover, and complaint information; needs for additional languages are unknown.
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_zh: 双语纸面卡、图形状态、柜台或人工转接；不得只给机器翻译而无人工纠错入口。
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_en: Bilingual paper card, pictorial status, counter, or human transfer; machine translation alone without a human correction channel is insufficient.
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_zh: 标注机器翻译并允许人工确认专名、风险和权利边界。
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_en: Label machine translation and allow human confirmation of proper names, risks, and rights boundaries.
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_zh: 可拒绝机器翻译并请求双语人工或静态材料；实际语言服务能力须开场前核验。
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_en: A user may refuse machine translation and request bilingual human or static material; actual language-service capacity must be verified before opening.

protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_zh: 人工、静态、离线脚本或纸面路径应达到同一核心目的；AI 路径不得成为唯一入口。
protected_user_equivalence.equivalent_service_en: A human, static, offline-script, or paper path should achieve the same core purpose; the AI route may not be the sole entry.
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_zh: 按场景使用离线评测脚本、仪表、陪同、议题墙、人工顾问、表格、静态地图、文字／音频、纸面反馈或柜台。
protected_user_equivalence.non_digital_entry_en: Depending on the scenario, use an offline evaluation script, meter, escort, issue wall, human adviser, sheet, static map, text/audio, paper feedback, or counter.
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_zh: 人工说明 AI 做了什么、没做什么、使用了哪些类别的数据以及如何停止和申诉。
protected_user_equivalence.human_explanation_en: A human explains what AI did and did not do, which data categories it used, and how to stop and appeal.
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_zh: 拒绝 AI 不需要提供理由，不触发画像、惩罚、资源剥夺或服务降级。
protected_user_equivalence.opt_out_en: Refusing AI requires no reason and triggers no profile, penalty, resource deprivation, or service downgrade.

pre_open_requirements: designate controller and operator roles in writing
publish category-specific purpose and minimum fields
set deletion batches and deletion-verification evidence
document any specifically required hold and its authority
test withdrawal and deletion without using real personal or sensitive data

numeric_duration_policy.rule_zh: 当前没有可核验的场景期限、响应时限或法定保留期。开放前拟定的所有数字均须标 design-target 并经运营、法律与安全复核。
numeric_duration_policy.rule_en: No verifiable scenario duration, response deadline, or statutory retention period is currently available. Every pre-open numeric target remains a design-target pending operations, legal, and security review.

retention_and_deletion_control.failure_rule: missing, unverifiable, or failed deletion triggers Human Takeover and stop/exit assessment; it is not silently retried or marked complete

separation_of_duties.scenario_operator: may operate and propose correction but may not close a complaint about its own conduct alone
separation_of_duties.human_takeover_role: may pause or stop service and provide the equivalent route
separation_of_duties.complaint_role: receives anonymous or identified complaints and separates contact from scenario data
separation_of_duties.accountable_reviewer: decides correction, stop, removal, reopen, or unresolved status
separation_of_duties.data_governance_role: verifies access, purpose, retention, deletion, and remote boundary

audit_and_appeal_control.unreachable_channel_rule: if a person cannot reach any complaint route or human transfer, switch to Human Takeover and assess pause/stop; do not count the complaint process as operational

uncertainty_register.resolution_gate: written designation and public notice before opening
field-level necessity, lawful-basis, controller, user-rights, and deletion review
written operations target plus legal and security review; no invented statutory deadline
approved data-flow diagram, processor boundary, security review, and legal review
rights-cleared field audit and named accountable staffing plan; no 24H claim without evidence
scenario-specific child-safety and legal review before any child data or interactive trial
product-by-product preflight; personal or sensitive processing remains outside the current first-use contract
item-level rights, permission/legal basis, display scope, correction, withdrawal, and deletion review before collection
